typed_geometry_path.public_new_evidence: New own-geometry values are computed only from both-public supported-XY contributors. Parent MAX also preserves inherited baseline own_geo; this is not a new provenance audit of every historical baseline value.
typed_geometry_path.source_empty_or_already_weaker: No source points/lines yields zero extra score; source proximity below inherited parent maximum yields no parent increase. Being eligible is not guaranteed positive delta or top100 admission.
typed_geometry_path.named_osm_separate: V143 named bonus uses supported own XY positions only and is not broadcast as parent geometry. Changing that would be a different source-role hypothesis, not correction of this mask; not proposed/authorized here.
typed_geometry_path.protected_receivers: Internal vectorized parent values may be formed for all keys, but final extra score is forced zero for eP/uP or other non-both-public receivers. No protected restoration follows.
